committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 19 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Weekly ad spend rose to $153.27 from $129.53 while clicks grew to 25 from 21, holding CPC at $6.13; with zero conversions tracked and the landing-page test at $265.17 of the $600 credit spent (creditRemainingExGst $280.64), cost per qualified enquiry still can't be worked out.

No external account changes in the last 24 hours or 7 days (externalLast24h and externalLast7d both 0), so this week's figures are clean; CTR climbed to 3.1% from 1.9% even as impressions fell to 801 from 1084, and budgetLost30d (21.2%) stays below rankLost30d (73.2%), so the test rule keeps budget fixed for now.

The landing-page test has logged 43 raw paid clicks and 10 ask_cta_click events since 6 Oct, but review_cta_click and generate_lead both sit at zero; past click 25 the page is frozen on headline, offer and CTAs unless something breaks.

AI Assistant sessions fell to 1 from 4 last7, with chatgpt.com still the only named source; Direct sessions rose to 16 from 14, which likely hides further unreferred AI traffic, while Organic Search, the only trustworthy unpaid signal, slipped to 16 from 18.

actions.text: The landing-page test has passed 43 raw clicks, well past the click-25 freeze point: headline, offer and CTAs stay locked unless the page is broken.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding; add them when ready.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still quote 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to match current site stats.
